_about: Extra Ribbit posts and trending tags, merged into ribbit.js POSTS/TAGS. Same when terms. Never pin.

posts.name: Lodge regular
posts.text: Ilse keeps a dream ledger at the Lodge. I did not ask what is in it. I wanted to.

posts.name: Lane sweeper
posts.text: Heard on the lane: 'A bond grows in small jobs.' My Walkling and I swept the step.

posts.name: Hill local
posts.text: Mrs. Calloway says Rook has a friend in mint. She said it like a weather report.

posts.name: Thrifty holder
posts.text: Had 3 Acorns for a 5 Acorn rest. Paid what I had. Slept fine.

posts.name: Meadow walker
posts.text: Took my Walkling to Old Meadow, where many holders took their very first walk. Now it's ours too.

posts.name: Board reader
posts.text: Officer Cald's gate count is up on the town board. Read it before you ask him.

posts.name: Gate watcher
posts.text: Rook at the east gate again. Competitive, kind underneath. Mostly competitive.

posts.name: Keeper House visitor
posts.text: Captain Lumen passed me: 'The watch is mine. The town is the lantern's.' Then he nodded.

posts.name: Schoolhouse parent
posts.text: Lizzy teaches 8-3 on weekdays. Buddy the Harvestail has better attendance than Pip and Wren.

posts.name: Amberhill tenant
posts.text: Leak in 5B. Lizzy is on one side of it, Mr. Gristle the other. The bucket is in the middle.

posts.name: Grass walker
posts.text: Tall grass all the way to Fernbrook. Every rustle is a shy Walkling or my nerves.

posts.name: New holder
posts.text: Officer Ness handed me a Keeper1. Free. Mandatory. Very shiny.

posts.name: Pole counter
posts.text: Asked about other networks. 'We own the poles from this hill to the coast.' Fair enough.

posts.name: Route regular
posts.text: My Keeper1 says: 'We can read this. That is the service.' Hello, Keepers. Nice weather.

posts.name: Rain walker
posts.text: Real rain on Route 1 today. Different Walklings stirring in the grass. Worth getting wet.

posts.name: Sproutbun holder
posts.text: Walked Route 1 with my Sproutbun. It stopped at every patch of tall grass to say hi.

posts.name: First-time poster
posts.text: First post. Ribbit rides the Keeper wires, so: hello, Keepers. Hello, grass.

posts.name: Grass walker
posts.text: You can hear Hearthmoor's east gate from the grass. Today it heard a Neighbour battle.

posts.name: Square regular
posts.text: 'Keepers keep the town. Glimmerwell keeps a stand.' The stand has better lighting.

posts.name: Orchard hand
posts.text: There's a grey Fuzzwick by Juniper's stand. Fuzzwicks love lanterns. This one looks tired.

posts.name: Orchard hand
posts.text: Pomlet today, Pomshell someday, Orchardon if it ever stops napping in my basket.

posts.name: Orchard hand
posts.text: Master Fen walks the orchard like she is counting friends. She is.

posts.name: Orchard hand
posts.text: Fen said 'Roots are a promise.' Then a holder opened the first crate at the gate.

posts.name: Square regular
posts.text: A holder got the Junior Bright trial lanyard. Tobin read the memo out loud for them.

posts.name: Orchard hand
posts.text: The Pomlets are out of the crates and back to bothering the blossoms.

posts.name: Orchard hand
posts.text: The Pomlets went into the crates a shade paler. The orchard is very quiet.

posts.name: Hall usher
posts.text: Fen handed over the Fernbrook Seal: 'Wear it kindly.' The orchard clapped. Mostly Pomlets.

posts.name: Square regular
posts.text: Saw the Bright Pavilion photos. A new Tier 1 holder, smiling beside the Sanctuary crate list.

posts.name: Ridge walker
posts.text: Fernbrook Heights: a lab, and old tunnels. Today mostly wind.

posts.name: Ridge walker
posts.text: Clerk Jed waved from the ridge. Night on the Heights is just night again.

posts.name: Tunnel watcher
posts.text: Mara Quill was wrong, not cruel. The tunnels are emptier either way.

posts.name: Lab visitor
posts.text: Everyone calls RegenX a lab of 'decent people'. Cal held the door for my Walkling.

posts.name: Lab visitor
posts.text: Someone copied an Atten vial 'for the partnership'. The lab got very polite after that.

posts.name: Bay sweeper
posts.text: The thing in the top bay floats. It emits slowly. The screen is dark. I stopped looking.

posts.name: Bay sweeper
posts.text: They call the floating computer a 'cradle'. Cradles rock. This one hummed, and a Bitlet woke.

posts.name: Lab visitor
posts.text: A Bitlet in the lab, of all things. 'It is not a product,' someone said. Firmly.

posts.name: Bay sweeper
posts.text: Asked Quinn what it sends. 'The old ones built it. That is all I was told.'
Hearthmoor: the Warden's Lodge is open. New holders, ask for Warden Ilse.
Somebody on the hill hit GLOWING. Care 75 and up. The whole hill has heard about it.
Route 1: Officer Ness is issuing the Keeper1. The Keeper High Court mandates one per holder.
A Neighbour battle at Hearthmoor's east gate. Rook: competitive. Kind underneath, sources say.
Fernbrook brief: orchards, the Bloom Trial Hall, and a Glimmerwell stand on the square.
Free lanterns in Fernbrook. 'Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting!' says a mint vest.
Fernbrook Seal awarded at the Bloom Trial Hall. Its holder now levels to 22.
RegenX had a quiet week, they say. The floating computer upstairs does not do weeks.
Heights: an Atten vial was copied at RegenX, filed 'for the partnership'.

posts.name: Route walker
posts.text: The Route 2 sign thanks Glimmerwell Co. crews. The grass thanks nobody.

posts.name: Route walker
posts.text: Walked past the Glow Census tent. My Walkling hid behind my boots till we were by.

posts.name: Long walker
posts.text: Fernbrook to Cobblecrest on foot. My Walkling wants a rest at both ends.

posts.name: Census walker
posts.text: Census folk say the Comfort Lamps pulse like a slow heartbeat. Mine just snores.

posts.name: Census helper
posts.text: Logged my census count. Standing went up. Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting, right?

posts.name: Route walker
posts.text: Walking beside the wild ones on Route 2, not ahead of them. Slow day, good day.

posts.name: Route walker
posts.text: The lamps are off up the glen path. Route 2 just smells like grass now.

posts.name: Long walker
posts.text: Made it to the Cobblecrest end of Route 2. Pebblits underfoot, as the sign promised.
Route 2 is open, Fernbrook to Cobblecrest. Path reopened by Glimmerwell Co. crews.

posts.name: Glen walker
posts.text: The sign says hush, please. I whispered all the way through. My Walkling did not.

posts.name: Glen walker
posts.text: Walklings nap here between the roots. I counted none, on purpose. Let them sleep.

posts.name: Glen walker
posts.text: Asked the quiet associate what his lamp does. He said, "I just hold the lamp."

posts.name: Glen walker
posts.text: Heard "Quarterly review, sweetie" under the lamps. To a lamp or a person? Hard to say.

posts.name: Root sitter
posts.text: The lamps collect a little extra glow, they say. Extra from where, though?

posts.name: Root sitter
posts.text: The lamps clicked off and the colour came back. Even the moss looks surprised.

posts.name: Root sitter
posts.text: The grey Pebblit by the roots needs care, not a lamp. Colour comes back with care.

posts.name: Lamp volunteer
posts.text: Field Lead calls it glow sharing. Sharing is caring. Right? Right.
Field Lead Imogen battles under her own Comfort Lamps? Bold spot for a quarterly review.
Wickerglen: a grey Pebblit was seen in the glen. Lantern Houses do not cure Fade. Care does.

posts.name: Quarry kid
posts.text: Master Hale says forty years he dug beside Walklings. His boots agree.

posts.name: Stone hauler
posts.text: Rested at Garnet's Lantern House. Five Acorns, a bed, and a talk about healing.

posts.name: Stone hauler
posts.text: Stopped by Shopkeeper Dottie's. A Pebblit underfoot followed me in.

posts.name: Quarry kid
posts.text: Brinewick road is closed while crates are loaded. Lots of crates. Lots of loading.

posts.name: Stone hauler
posts.text: Three votes. That is what it came down to. Three.

posts.name: Quarry kid
posts.text: My Pebblit is not a unit. Told the Acquisitions man so. Politely.

posts.name: Stone hauler
posts.text: The Reeve says the vote passed fair and square. She wishes it felt fair. Same.

posts.name: Quarry kid
posts.text: Clerk Mint runs the Bright Quarry desk now. Very bright. Very mint.

posts.name: Quarry kid
posts.text: Someone walked out of Hale's Hall with the Cobblecrest Seal. A Pebblit rolled over. That counts.

posts.name: Stone hauler
posts.text: Three Pebblits out of their crates, and Hale opened the seam. The quarry sounds like itself.

posts.name: Crate packer
posts.text: Stamped BRINEWICK on the last crates. Crates packed count. Output and quotas!

posts.name: Stream walker
posts.text: The Old Weir on Hushwater was built by Cobblecrest miners. Still holding. Old miner energy.

posts.name: Stream walker
posts.text: The Fallstair says CLOSED FOR SURVEY. The stream did not read the sign.

posts.name: Stream walker
posts.text: A Keeper scout is mapping Hushwater for Captain Lumen. Quiet work, quiet stream.
Cobblecrest vote: passed by three votes. The quarry is now Bright Quarry, a Glimmerwell Co. site.
Glimmerwell's Head of Acquisitions is in Cobblecrest. The Pebblits were not consulted.
Cobblecrest Stone Hall: Master Hale gave his Seal. Two Seals raise the cap to Lv 30.
Tier 2 Lanyards are out at Cobblecrest. Insiders mention a soft click. Probably the lanyard.
Word is Neighbour Rook got off the cart. Somebody tell Mrs. Calloway.
Hushwater: the Fallstair is closed for survey. The Old Weir, built by Cobblecrest miners, stands.

posts.name: Woods walker
posts.text: Time snags in these woods. I have been finishing this post for a while.

posts.name: Woods walker
posts.text: The observatory says the lens remembers. I would rather it forgot my hair.

posts.name: Woods walker
posts.text: Asked a neighbour what day it is. Same answer as last time. Mahopac.

posts.name: Trail walker
posts.text: Mom sent me up here. A bond grows in small jobs, she says. This feels like a big one.

posts.name: Lens visitor
posts.text: Saw my old pop toy from 2004 through the lens. Still pops. Long story.

posts.name: Lens visitor
posts.text: A seventh birthday at a bowling alley. The lens remembers it better than I do.

posts.name: Lens visitor
posts.text: Dad at the drive-through: "Eat up. The world can wait." Okay, Dad.

posts.name: Trail walker
posts.text: A Walkling trusts you faster once it has seen who you were. Mine has seen a lot now.
Mahopac is time-snagged again. Or still. Hard to file.

posts.name: Capital local
posts.text: Counted the lanterns on our street again. Every roof. Still lit.

posts.name: Marina walker
posts.text: Be kind in the streets, they say. A Walkling waited for me at the marina. Point taken.

posts.name: Coach rider
posts.text: Porter Quin helped my Walkling onto the Lantern Coach. It took the window seat.

posts.name: Event Hall regular
posts.text: Five games at the Event Hall. I'm good at one of them. Not saying which.

posts.name: Practice regular
posts.text: Lost again at the practice hall. No Seal on the line, so no shame either.

posts.name: Airship Field fan
posts.text: Lunch by the Airship Field. My Walkling is sure the ships are very big birds.

posts.name: Civic Bank regular
posts.text: Civic Bank queue is slow. Plenty of time to count my Acorns twice.

posts.name: Chapel bench
posts.text: The Chapel is the quietest room in High Charity. My Walkling snored anyway.

posts.name: Lantern House guest
posts.text: Ines at the Lantern House explained healing twice. Kindly. I needed it twice.

posts.name: Barracks neighbour
posts.text: A mint vest knocked at a Keeper door today. Asked to leave. Very politely.

posts.name: Capital local
posts.text: Lights on late in the capital. Lantern Council, someone said. The lanterns didn't mind.

posts.name: Coast walker
posts.text: The Brinewick road is long. My Walkling insisted on every single step.

posts.name: Relay neighbour
posts.text: 'The hum is normal,' says the Relay House. I am choosing to believe the Relay House.

posts.name: Ledger runner
posts.text: Shipping Ledger Office: lots of pages. I don't ask what ships.

posts.name: Coast walker
posts.text: Passed the Comfort Sanctuary. Nobody could tell me where the crated Walklings go.

posts.name: Gate watcher
posts.text: Rook was waiting at the Route 3 gate for a holder. Neighbour things.

posts.name: Lair spotter
posts.text: Tallybat, Dimlamp, Filecrow, Cordhound, Humwisp. I say it like a skipping rhyme now.

posts.name: Lair spotter
posts.text: It was Quiet. Then it was Humming. I did not wait for Answering.

posts.name: Relay neighbour
posts.text: 'The hum woke them.' Lovely. Something to think about at bedtime.

posts.name: Coast walker
posts.text: Keepers say Answerers. Mint vests say Founder's Line. The five say nothing at all.

posts.name: Pier walker
posts.text: Ferry's at the west pier. Bring a snack. The wait is half the trip.

posts.name: Ferry rider
posts.text: Master Marisol said the tide's out and to sit a while. So I sat a while.

posts.name: Harbour hand
posts.text: My Walkling sat in the Chandlery doorway like it owned the place.

posts.name: Harbour hand
posts.text: The Glimmerwell Depot by the harbour has lots of crates and not many answers.

posts.name: Net mender
posts.text: Our Lantern Host still has no name tag. Still heals you. Still explains it slowly.

posts.name: Net mender
posts.text: Someone opened a depot crate. A grey little Drizzlet. Care brings the colour back.

posts.name: Pier walker
posts.text: Dorian Pell called Walklings 'units' on our quay. The quay has opinions.

posts.name: Ferry rider
posts.text: Marisol handed out the Brinewick Seal, then went straight back to the ferry.

posts.name: Pier walker
posts.text: A review on the quay and a Tier 3 Lanyard. Marisol's match was optional. Noted.

posts.name: Net mender
posts.text: Grey tower on the skyline. The clouds over it went flat as a table. Not mending that.
Event Hall, High Charity: five games, six regulars, one holder losing at the same game.
High Charity: the Lantern Council has met. Leave glow where it grows.
Reminder: the Keeper High Court mandates a phone for every holder.
Route 3, the Brinewick road, is walkable. Relay House says the hum is normal.
Five Walklings on the Brinewick road rank Quiet, Humming, Answering. Nobody grows up.
Brinewick: ferry at the west pier. Tide Hall under Master Marisol.
A Faded Drizzlet came out of a Brinewick crate. Somebody bring it a snack.
Brinewick desk: holders report a grey tower. The clouds above it are flat.
Signal Review recap: relays, a warning, and a cursor typing COUNT. GATHER. LISTEN.
Overheard: 'The lamps don't count glow. They count Walklings.' Then a long pause.
Tier 2 holders say their Walklings tilt their heads at nothing now. Must be the air.
